name: YFG Gigerish [Flux | Krea]
description: YFG Gigerish Krea – Biomechanical Surrealism (Giger-inspired) Style Dark, bio-mechanical surrealism: osseous metals, ribbed exoskeletons, tubing/cables, and cathedral-like machinery fused with fleshlike textures. Works for colossal biomech monuments as well as intimate skull-and-mask close-ups. Trigger No dedicated trigger. Guide with phrases such as “biomechanical,” “bio-organic,” “ribbed exoskeleton,” “tubing and cables,” “biomech cathedral,” “chrome-bone surfaces,” or “industrial fog and backlight.” Strength Tested 0.30 – 1.00 . Sweet spot ≈ 0.50 for balanced biomech detail and prompt fidelity. Higher values intensify cables, plating, and skeletal motifs; lower values add subtler Gigerish accents. Key Characteristics Chrome-Bone Surfaces – Polished gunmetal, bone-ivory plates, oil-slick blacks, and etched ridges. Sinew & Cabling – Bundled hoses, spinal conduits, and tendon-like wiring integrating with hard armor. Skulls & Masks – Elongated crania, faceless visors, hollow eye sockets, and ritualistic helms. Monumental Architecture – Towering bio-mechanical altars, rib vaults, and pipe-organs shrouded in mist. Industrial Atmosphere – Volumetric fog, teal/amber rim lights, sparks, and cold steel environments. Prompt Ideas “Colossal biomech monument rising from fog, ribbed conduits feeding a chrome-bone face, cinematic backlight.” “Close-up skull mask with glowing eyes, etched plating and bundled cables, dark moody portrait.” “Bio-organic cathedral interior with spinal arches and tubing corridors, pilgrims in silhouette.” “Ancient statue reimagined as biomechanical guardian, gunmetal plates and sinewy wiring, low-key lighting.” “Helmeted sentinel with chrome-bone armor, industrial mist, teal rim light and subtle sparks.” Tips & Tricks Light for Metal & Mist – Use “neon rim light,” “volumetric fog,” “HDR reflections,” or “backlit smoke” to sell surfaces. Control Complexity – If scenes get chaotic, drop strength toward 0.45–0.55 or add negatives like “avoid excessive cables,” “no heavy glare,” “keep face readable.” Palette Direction – Specify “gunmetal + bone ivory,” “black chrome with red optics,” or “teal/orange accents” to steer color. Scale & Drama – For epic structures, include “monumental,” “cathedral,” “towering,” and wide-angle vantage cues. Blend With Other LoRAs – Pair with YFG Daak , YFG FaceGear , or geometric/lighting models; keep Gigerish Krea around 0.5–0.7 so collaborators remain visible. Forge nightmarish elegance—from towering biomech shrines to intimate skull studies—by dialing YFG Gigerish Krea to taste and shaping your prompts around cables, ribbing, chrome-bone textures, and cinematic light.
